description: This file contains functions for upgrading the firmware of GL.iNet devices, specifically handling FIT images and default sysupgrade procedures.

methods.name: glinet_do_fit_upgrade
methods.description: Extracts UBI from a FIT image and replaces the firmware's UBI; proceeds with sysupgrade if successful.

methods.name: glinet_do_upgrade
methods.description: Validates the firmware image and delegates to the appropriate upgrade method based on image type.
